coordinate_meaning: Source_unit_execution.csv maps every original cell to its exact first-pass execution state in both axes and all3 orientations, including zero-operation cells. Source positions and pass numbers are distinct axes.
boundary_conclusion: No source-authored start/end rule has been identified. Many different source paths yield the same pass100 register vector, so the vector alone does not identify a unique source span. All coordinate and run transitions remain recorded for further comparisons.
